findings.title: Body is close to the floor
findings.message: `bolt_b0` is -0.25 mm above the floor; it will scrape on arena seams and ride on the ground when a tyre compresses.
findings.fix: Raise the chassis or use a bigger wheel; wedges and forks may go lower.

findings.title: Front rests on the wedge
findings.message: About 35% of the weight sits on the wedge tip because the centre of mass is ahead of the axle; the tip drags and wears and the drive loses traction.
findings.fix: Move the battery and motors back, or add a front skid wheel, or put the axle forward.

findings.title: Battery may sag under peak load
findings.message: Estimated peak 17.0 A against a 7.2 A rating (180 mAh x 40 C); the voltage will collapse in a hit.
findings.fix: Use a bigger or higher-C pack, or a motor that draws less.

findings.fix: Thicken that wall to a multiple of the nozzle width (0.8, 1.2, 1.6 mm) or merge it into a thicker feature.

findings.title: Weapon on a shaft gripped on both sides
findings.message: `blade_c` turns on `wshaft`, which sits 6.0 mm and 8.8 mm in structure or bearings either side (need 3).

findings.title: Weapon does not lead the front
findings.message: Looking -30 degrees off straight ahead the chassis or a non-ground-game part is -1.6 mm ahead of `blade_c`; the opponent meets it first.
findings.fix: Cut the wedge back or move the weapon forward until it leads by 5-10 mm across plus or minus 30 degrees.

findings.title: Weapon is a small share of the robot
findings.message: `blade_c` is 13.1 g, 9% of 147 g; spinners that win put 25-40% of the mass into the weapon (warns below 20%).

findings.title: Weapon stores little energy
findings.message: `blade_c` stores 3.4 J at 85% speed (0.02 J per gram of robot; warns below 0.10, i.e. 15 J at 150 g).
findings.fix: Raise the moment of inertia (larger radius, mass at the rim) before raising rpm.

findings.title: Weapon does not reach the floor both ways up
findings.message: `blade_c` is 5.6 mm above the floor upright and -0.2 mm below the floor plane when inverted; it must be within 2 mm either way.
findings.fix: Centre the weapon on the body mid-plane and size it so its rim just touches the floor plane either way up.

findings.title: Robot cannot run upside down
findings.message: A vertical spinner gets flipped often; if it cannot drive inverted it is out of the fight the first time that happens.

findings.title: Part sits outside the armour
findings.message: `weapon_motor` has a clear path to open air from 38% of its outward rays; a hit or the floor reaches it directly.
findings.fix: Move it inside the shell or add an armour wall (1.2 mm nylon, or 0.8 mm steel or titanium) on the open side.
